input.sha256_scope: Exact UTF-8 manifest file; the fixture's input and its expectation are the same document, because a manifest is validated by parsing it.
input.provenance: Self-authored. Every digest, revision, byte count, and tensor name in it is copied from docs/MODEL_CANDIDATES.md and the committed end-to-end fixtures, which recorded them first. No artifact bytes are present.

limitations: This records identity and provenance, not resolution. Nothing loads a model from it yet; MOD-003 owns turning a manifest into loaded sessions, and until then the digests here and the digests a caller passes on the command line are maintained separately.
It records URLs and never fetches them. A URL in this file is provenance, not a download instruction, and MOD-004 remains unapproved.
The tensor contract is recorded as input and output names only. The per-axis extents this port enforces live in code, so a manifest cannot yet relax or tighten them.
One manifest for one artifact pair. It demonstrates the schema; it is not a registry, and a second pair needs its own verification under LANG-001 rather than another row here.
